title: Incident INC-2026-042: Application Load Balancer HTTP 502 Bad Gateway Outage
description: On 2026-04-12 at 10:15 UTC, the main production ingress ALB returned HTTP 502 Bad Gateway responses for 100% of incoming HTTPS traffic on port 443.
root_cause: The backend application service (Gunicorn Python API) crashed due to an unhandled memory exception, causing target instances to reset TCP connections during ALB health check requests.
resolution: Restarted web server service via systemctl on backend targets i-01112223334445556 and i-09988776655443322. Increased Gunicorn worker memory limits.
lessons_learned: Target health checks must have automated systemd restart policies enabled so crashed target processes recover without manual intervention.
